Security

Your keys stay on your phone.

Prime Way is self-custody. Your keys are created on your phone and they never leave it. Nobody at Prime Way can move your money, and there is no account to sign in to.

What it can access

The app asks Android for only these permissions:

  • Internet, so it can send and receive
  • Vibration, for tap feedback
  • Biometric and fingerprint, to unlock with your face or finger
  • Read and write external storage, for your wallet backup
  • Draw over other apps, for payment confirmations

Support

Questions, problems or a download that does not match the checksum above: open an issue on the project page and you will get help there.

Install

On your phone in under a minute.

1

Download the APK

Tap Download APK on this page, on your Android phone.

2

Open the file

When the download finishes, tap the file to open it.

3

Allow the install

If Android asks, allow install from unknown sources for your browser, just this once.

4

Open the app

Tap Install, then open Prime Way and set up your wallet.

Why an APK?

Prime Way is not on Google Play yet. The APK is the same app, signed and checksum verified. You can check the file against the SHA-256 in the Security section before you install it.

Yes. Android shows this message for every app installed outside the Play Store. Check that the file name is Prime-Way-1.0.0.apk and that the checksum matches the one in the Security section, then tap Install anyway.
